period_boundaries.handling: The exports are broadcast-day exports with per-channel handover, so no single instant cleanly separates them. Timestamps are inclusive at an airing's start and exclusive at start + duration. Period membership is the source export label, which is unambiguous.

boundary_session_rule.description: A session whose labelled matches span both weeks 11-20 and weeks 21-30 is assigned to the period of its earliest matched airing, ordered by airing start (pstart) ascending and then period ascending as a deterministic tie-breaker. Only events whose airing period equals the assigned period are retained. A session is never counted in both splits. Neither viewing stop time nor total overlap seconds is used, so validation-period overlap cannot influence which training events are kept.
